beliefs: The box inserts a single 'Z' into the input string [E1, E2, E3]
For a single character, 'Z' is prepended (position 0) [E1: 'a'->'Za', 'A'->'ZA', '1'->'Z1', '!'->'Z!', ' '->'Z', 'Z'->'ZZ', 'z'->'Zz']
For length 2, 'Z' is inserted at index 1 [E2: 'ab'->'aZb', 'a b'->'aZb', ' ab'->'aZb', 'ab '->'aZb']
For length 3, 'Z' is inserted at index 1 [E1: 'abc'->'aZbc', 'a1'->'aZ1' (len2), '  '->'Z' (all spaces?), 'a  b'->'aZb']
For length 4, 'Z' is inserted at index 2 [E2: 'abcd'->'abZcd', 'a b c'->'aZbc' (len5?), E3: 'aZb'->'aZZb', '  a'->'Za']
For length 5, 'Z' is inserted at index 2 [E2: 'abcde'->'abZcde', 'a b c'->'aZbc', 'xy z'->'xZyz']
For length 8, 'Z' is inserted at index 4 [E3: 'abcdefgh'->'abcdZefgh']
For length 6, 'Z' is inserted at index 3 [E3: 'a1b2c3'->'a1bZ2c3']
For length 5 with symbols, 'Z' is inserted at index 2 [E3: 'a!b?c'->'a!Zb?c']
For length 11, 'Z' is inserted at index 5 [E2: 'hello world'->'helloZworld']
For length 5, 'Z' is inserted at index 2 [E3: 'abZcd'->'abZZcd']
Insertion position appears to be floor(len/2) for length>=2, except length 2 and 3 use index 1 [E1,E2,E3]?
